title: Induction principle for quasi-compact opens
statement: Let X be a quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme] quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let P be a property of its quasi-compact open subschemes. If P holds for every affine open and whenever U is quasi-compact open and V is affine open, P holds for U, V, and U intersect V implies P holds for U union V, then P holds for every quasi-compact open of X, in particular X.

proof.text: First prove the assertion for separated quasi-compact opens W. Choose a finite affine open cover W = U_1 union ... union U_n using the finite-affine-cover lemma. Induct on n. The case n = 1 is the affine hypothesis. For n > 1 put U = U_1 union ... union U_{n-1} and V = U_n. The open U is quasi-compact, and U intersect V is the union of the n-1 affine opens U_i intersect V: each intersection is affine because W is separated, by the affine-intersection lemma. The opens U and U intersect V of W are separated: the inclusion of an open subscheme is an open immersion, hence separated by [lem-weil-pbc-separated-cancellation](a), and its composite with the separated structure morphism W -> Spec Z is separated by [lem-weil-pbc-proper-fp-permanence](e). The induction hypothesis applies to U and to U intersect V, while the affine hypothesis applies to V; the assumed gluing implication therefore gives P(W).

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 08DR proof, first paragraph (separated quasi-compact opens); Tags 01IT and 01KP

proof.text: Now prove the assertion for an arbitrary quasi-compact open W by induction on the number n of affine opens in a finite affine cover W = U_1 union ... union U_n. The case n = 1 is the affine hypothesis. For n > 1 put U = U_1 union ... union U_{n-1} and V = U_n. The open U is quasi-compact. The overlap U intersect V is a quasi-compact open because X is quasi-separated and U is a finite union of affine opens; it is separated because it is an open subscheme of the affine scheme V: the inclusion U intersect V -> V is an open immersion, hence separated by [lem-weil-pbc-separated-cancellation](a), and V is affine, so U intersect V is separated by [lem-sc-separated-over-affine-scheme-separated]. By the separated-open result, P(U intersect V) holds. The induction hypothesis gives P(U), and P(V) is the affine case, so the assumed gluing implication gives P(W).

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 08DR proof, second paragraph (arbitrary quasi-compact opens); Tags 01IT and 01KO

proof.text: Applying the preceding conclusion to the quasi-compact open W = X yields P(X), as required.
